description: This file implements the MediaPipelineModuleService class, which manages media pipeline sessions, client connections, and media source operations via IPC in a media server context. It includes methods for creating/destroying sessions, loading media, attaching/removing sources, playback controls, and querying media state.

classes.name: MediaPipelineModuleService
classes.description: Implements the IPC-based media pipeline management, handling client sessions, media source operations, and playback controls.

classes.name: CodecData
classes.description: Holds codec data information used when attaching media sources.

classes.name: MediaSource
classes.description: Abstract base class for media source representations.

classes.name: MediaSourceVideoDolbyVision
classes.description: Represents a Dolby Vision video media source.

classes.name: MediaPipelineClient
classes.description: Client callback handler for media pipeline events.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Handles new client connection, exports service to client.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection, cleans up sessions.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new media pipeline session for a client.

methods.name: destroySession
methods.description: Destroys an existing media pipeline session.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads media into a session.

methods.name: setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the video window parameters for a session.

methods.name: attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to a session.

methods.name: removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from a session.

methods.name: allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached in a session.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback in a session.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback in a session.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback in a session.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets playback position in a session.

methods.name: haveData
methods.description: Informs the pipeline about media data availability.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for a session.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves current playback position.

methods.name: renderFrame
methods.description: Renders a video frame.

methods.name: setVolume
methods.description: Sets the volume for a session.

methods.name: getVolume
methods.description: Gets the current volume.

methods.name: setMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the session.

methods.name: getMute
methods.description: Retrieves mute status.
